scenario: 今日个性化这边，一条线把歌曲、歌单和播客里的稳定偏好从各域特有偏好里拆开，避免高流量域压过弱域；一条线追问教育推荐的离线分数到底在预测学生需要，还是在模仿平台怎么排课；还有一条线把推荐嵌进电影整理界面，看意外发现是不是主要来自列表本身。网易云音乐的线上测试里，三个音频域的播放或点赞都有提升。只根据上一个活动的结构预测，已经能接近最好离线成绩的中位水平，说明评测可能在学平台路径。空间整理实验则表明，推荐也可能只是促使用户自己再去搜、再去看已经认识的片子。

papers.title: Multi-Modal Causal Disentanglement for Multi-Domain Sequential Audio Recommendation
papers.authors: Yu Ren, Pengcheng Li, Weijun Xu, Hengzhong Zhou, Shufeng Ye, Qiang Xiao, Dongjing Wang, Chuanjiang Luo, Yong Li
papers.abstract: Modern music platforms expose users to heterogeneous audio content domains such as songs, playlists, and podcasts. Multi-domain sequential recommendation (MDSR) seeks to exploit such cross-domain behavior, yet two obstacles persist in practice. First, joint optimization across heterogeneous domains is prone to negative transfer, with high-traffic domains dominating the shared parameter space and suppressing weaker domains. Second, conventional ID-based collaborative signals fail to bridge domains that are semantically related but exhibit little behavioral overlap. This paper presents CAMAR, a multi-modal causal disentanglement framework for multi-domain audio recommendation. From a causal perspective, user behavior is modeled as the joint outcome of a domain-invariant preference and domain-specific preferences. Guided by this view, CAMAR factorizes user representations into domain-invariant and domain-specific components and enforces domain adversarial invariance together with orthogonality, restricting cross-domain interaction to the invariant subspace and suppressing harmful transfer paths. To strengthen cross-domain semantic coupling, CAMAR derives trainable semantic-ID embeddings from pre-trained text, vision, and audio features through residual quantization, yielding an end-to-end multi-modal adaptation tailored to recommendation. A transfer network imputes user representations for inactive domains, mitigating cross-domain cold start. Experiments on both public and industrial datasets demonstrate consistent gains over strong baselines. In online A/B tests on NetEase Cloud Music, one of China's largest music streaming platforms, CAMAR delivers consistent gains across all three domains in their main traffic scenarios, validating its effectiveness in multi-domain audio recommendation at scale.
papers.summary: 音乐平台上，同一用户会在歌曲、歌单和播客之间切换，偏好既互相牵连又并不相同。联合训练时，高流量域容易占满共享参数，把弱域压下去；只靠物品 ID，也很难把语义相近、行为却很少重叠的内容连起来。CAMAR 把用户表示拆成跨域稳定偏好和各域特有偏好，只用稳定那一部分做跨域交互，再用文本、封面和音频得到的 Semantic ID 补上内容层面的联系。对还没在某域活跃过的用户，它用迁移网络补出表示，减轻跨域冷启动。在网易云音乐主流量场景的线上 A/B 测试里，实验组只是在原有分域召回上多加一路通道，歌曲和播客的播放时长分别提高 1.0% 和 1.6%，歌单的点赞率提高 3.0%。

papers.title: Learning the Platform, Not the Learner: Sequencing Shortcuts in the Offline Evaluation of Educational Recommender Systems and LLM Rankers
papers.abstract: Educational recommenders are usually compared offline, by how well they predict the next activity in logs of tutoring systems, learning applications and MOOCs, where the next activity is largely decided by the platform: teachers assign problem sets, tutors draw problems until mastery, engines select questions. On eight public datasets from five platforms, we compare four structural predictors, which use nothing about the learner beyond the last activity, with ten personalised recommenders and with open-weight LLM rankers from 0.5 to 7 billion parameters, under two protocols. The structural predictors reach between 0.81 and 1.00 of the best accuracy of any method (median 0.95), mostly through population transitions rather than the course order; the best personalised recommender is significantly better on five datasets, by 0.007 to 0.102 NDCG@10, and on Eedi in three of four training runs. Every method is far less accurate on steps along transitions never seen in training and on steps chosen by learners. LLM rankers look competent with random negatives but are never much better than a word-matching baseline, and with negatives that are plausible under the course structure they stay close to random or well behind the transition heuristic, whatever their size. In a simulation with known learner needs, the structural share tracks the share of steps decided by the platform, and offline accuracy ranks an oracle of the learners' needs below imitators of the platform. Weighting test steps by how unlikely the structure makes them restores much of the link with usefulness and, on the real data, reveals a significant personalisation signal on seven of the eight datasets. We propose a syllabus-aware evaluation checklist and release a Python package that reports the lift of any recommender over the structure.
papers.summary: 教育推荐常用离线指标，看模型能不能预测日志里的下一步，可下一步往往是平台安排的：老师布置习题，练习到掌握再换题。在来自五个平台的八个公开数据集上，只根据上一个活动做预测的结构方法，就能达到所有方法里最好成绩的中位数 0.95。最好的个性化推荐器只在五个数据集上显著更好。大模型排序在看起来符合课程结构的候选上，并不比按活动转移来推荐的方法强多少。模拟里，离线准确度甚至会把真正按学生需要推荐的方法，排到模仿平台路径的方法后面。按结构罕见程度给测试步加权后，多数数据集上又能看到个性化信号。==离线评测很可能是在学平台怎么排内容，而不是学生需要什么。==

papers.title: RecField: Embedding Recommendations into Spatial Movie Organization as Affordances for Serendipitous Encounters
papers.abstract: Research on serendipity-oriented recommender systems has focused on algorithms that recommend unexpected yet useful items. However, serendipity is increasingly viewed as a user experience shaped by both algorithmic outputs and system features. This study positions recommendations not as the primary goal users pursue but as an environmental affordance that creates opportunities for discovery during other activities. We propose RecField, a spatial movie organization interface where users freely arrange movies into collection zones. For each collection, RecField provides attribute-based recommendation lists labeled according to their recommendation perspectives. A between-subjects experiment ($N$ = 57) examined the effects of recommendations on discoveries made during a foreground task of creating and organizing personal movie profiles. Although recommendations did not significantly affect environment-level perceived serendipity, ratings of encounter-related aspects tended to be higher, with small effect sizes. At the individual-movie level, favorites in the recommendation condition received significantly higher ratings for stimulating the desire to watch and broadening preferences, but not for novelty or unexpectedness. Notably, only 14\% of evaluated favorites in the recommendation condition were added directly from recommendation lists. Differences in ratings showed similar effect sizes even when the analysis was restricted to favorites added through other routes. These findings suggest that embedded recommendations can contribute to serendipitous experiences both directly through item acceptance and indirectly by prompting users' own exploration and re-evaluation. They also highlight the value of evaluating serendipity at both the environment and item levels and the limitations of relying solely on direct recommendation acceptance rates.
papers.summary: 意外发现不一定出在推荐列表上。一个空间整理界面里，用户把电影放进自己的收藏分区，系统再按不同角度给出推荐，推荐被当成整理过程里的环境条件，而不是用户要完成的主任务。57 人对照实验里，有没有推荐，并没有显著改变对整个环境是否会遇到意外好片的感受。但在推荐条件下，收藏影片在激发想看和拓宽口味上的评分显著更高。这些被评价的收藏里，只有 14% 是直接从推荐列表加进去的，而且只看从别的路径加入的收藏，组间差异仍然在。推荐嵌在整理过程里，既可能被直接采纳，也可能只是促使用户自己再去搜、再去看一眼已经认识的片子。只看列表点击或直接采纳率，会把这条间接路径漏掉。
